propositions: ADR 0098 must document the approved RP-04 architecture decision on operation-scoped configuration and provider-auth/runtime-binding composition as a standalone Proposed/Accepted decision before implementation begins
The ADR must cite specific primary-source research findings and maintained OSS behavior for all external-dependency and Rebar-probe claims with traceable references to durable research artifacts

The ADR must record approved decisions on operation snapshot lifecycle, CLI/MCP/Python/service composition ownership, provider-native pre-client auth injection, static secret carriers, subprocess environment rules, static restart/redeploy rotation, SDK-owned refresh, fail-closed auth, op-cert single-path startup validation, and optional observability exceptions

The ADR must narrow ADR 0049 only at per-job retrieval/composition and explicitly preserve its unaffected decisions while clarifying relationships to ADRs 0008, 0014, 0041, 0046, 0050, 0059, and 0083 without claiming supersession

Generated `docs/adr/README.md`, `.numbers/0098`, and minimal updates to `docs/architecture.md` must pass deterministic index/number/documentation checks and contain no placeholder sections or merge-conflict markers

A numbered Draft Critique must identify or explicitly clear uncited claims, inconsistencies, missing constraints, and ADR conflicts; HOLD and implementation require explicit maintainer approval after Gerrit LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, and no unresolved comments
